root: ^Hello, and welcome to the Plûsh Brûlée!
^My name is Inky. A pleasure to make your acquaintance!
^We don't have too much time to chat; the bakery opens in 5 minutes.
^But we are excited to welcome you to the team!
^There is a lot for you to help with around here.
^You see, working is very hard for plushies.
^People love to see us baking our delicious sweet treats...
^But plushies lack attention spans and get distracted easily.
^As an intern and staff support project lead, your objective is to make sure our coworkers stay on task.
^They know what to do and where to find ingredients. Just give them a poke to recenter their focus.
^Miss Yuzu brings us fresh ingredients and delivers our products directly to customers!
^When you see her, be sure to say hello. You can pet her too; she loves it!
^Anyway, it's opening time! We will talk more later.
^When you need a break from bakery life, the green door leads back to the break room!
^I hope you enjoy your week of internship!
